description: Welcome to San Francisco! Looking for the perfect place to stay while visiting the city? Located just a short walk from Mission, you'll be able to explore the city easily. Whether you're in town for business or pleasure, this urban paradise will make you feel right at home. A bonus - easy street parking! Book your stay today!

name: Private Guest suite in San Francisco
description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful suite . Located in a quiet neighborhood, our place offers privacy and comfort. Please be sure to read the house rules before booking.While we do not provide parking, there is street parking available in the neighborhood. We are just a 5-minute drive from SFSU and 10 minutes from the San Francisco Zoo. Restaurants are conveniently located at the corner, and the bus stop is right in front of the house (only 20 minutes to downtown San Francisco).

name: Gorgeous corner unit, Art Deco bldg, gym, 1mo min
description: Large studio in landmark Art Deco Building, sleeps 1-2. Beautifully furnished with separate, well-designed bed alcove. Well-suited for home office and remote work, with expandable desk/dining table in an airy living space with ample natural light and fast wifi. Redesigned butcher block with bar stools next to the fully equipped kitchen make for elegant open-space living and entertaining. Fully equipped gym ansun deck. Smart TV. Stunning views of downtown and San Francisco Bay. 30-day minimum.

name: 1000 Fulton Events Package
description: Private dining for up to 30, and the option to add up to 8 suites and 10 as needed for overnight stays. Welcome to the former Archbishop’s Mansion, in the heart of Alamo Square. With expansive historic rooms and grand function spaces, there’s nothing quite like it in the city.

name: San Francisco Suite w/ Amenities
description: Just one block from Union Square, this resort is ideally located to explore all the San Francisco sights. Just a short walk or iconic cable car ride away from popular attractions in the Bay Area & Michelin star eateries. • Must be 18+ to book. • Must provide $250 fully refundable deposit to the resort at check in for incidentals (credit card only). • Valet parking only ($45/day + tax). • Name on reservation must match photo I.D.

name: Cozy Queen bed with a rooftop
description: Discover San Francisco from your private room in our centrally located and safe Pacific Heights home. Ideal for remote workers and tourists, your room boasts a queen bed, a workstation, lots of natural light, and a closet. Please note the bathroom is shared. Enjoy access to a fully equipped kitchen, free in-unit laundry, and a rooftop deck with stunning views. Just minutes from downtown and attractions like Lombard Street, our home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

name: 2bd/2ba 3-Floor Mission Condo
description: Stylish three level townhome/loft style home in the Mission with private outdoor space. The first and third floors of the unit each has its own bedroom and bathroom, making the space easy to divide between two distinct parties. The unit has easy walking access to numerous bars and restaurants in the area, as well as public transportation with the 16th and 24th St BART stations nearby.

name: Pano View Executive Top Level Unit in Cow Hollow
description: Panoramic view of San Francisco Bay, Golden Gate Bridge, Marin Headlands and Alcatraz. Executive top level unit with 25 foot north facing windows offer plenty of sun light. Rest in bed, relax on lounger, work at desk or soak in tub while watching the ships and fog roll by with the gas fireplace keeping you warm and toasty. Walking distance to ample stores and restaurants on Union Street and Fillmore Street. This is the quintessential San Francisco experience. Don't miss it!

name: Cozy Room with Private Bath & Patio in Pac Heights
description: Located in the heart of vibrant Fillmore District and Japantown - it's the perfect retreat for vacationers and business travelers who are looking to explore the city. You’d love this lively fun neighborhood with so many options to wine and dine, shop, and exercise. Easy walk to Alta plaza and Lafayette parks. You will not be disappointed!

name: New studio on Market St - [30+ day booking]
description: Brand new one bedroom studio in the heart of downtown San Francisco on Market St, right off the Powell St Bart station. This is a fully FURNISHED unit, a totally move-in ready. All new appliance and furnitures, never been used. This studio include: built-in refrigerator, dishwasher, gas stove, washer & dryer, 55" TV, queen-size sofa-bed and queen size Murphy bed (convertible to a desk). This building has 24/7 security on duty, gym, club house, roof top garden, community BBQ and bike storage.

name: Junior 1 Bedroom in SoMA CoLiving Community - RARE
description: Be a part of the SF tech and entrepreneurial world! This private junior bedroom in the heart of SoMa is the perfect way for you to immerse yourself in the coliving community of San Francisco. Please note this is not a boutique hotel, this property is part of a coliving community with other residents occupying the space looking to make their mark on the world. Immerse yourself in San Francisco's unique culture and explore all it has to offer, and get a taste of the coliving lifestyle!

name: Stylish bedroom in Union Square
description: Designed by Philippe Starck, this stylish hotel is a 6-minute walk from upscale shopping at Union Square and 4 minutes' walk from a Muni Metro station. Featuring custom furniture, the warm rooms come with flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. There's an opulent lounge with velvet sofas, and a glamorous redwood-paneled bar offering dinner and live music. The lobby displays a collection of furniture by famous artists and designers. There's also a 24/7 gym.

name: Sun-Lit Inner Sunset Hideaway
description: Sun rolls into this bedroom suite with windows on three sides. Large living room with radiant heat (nothing like a warm floor!) A sofa-bed with chaise, reading lamp and work/ eating table complete the room. A kitchenette along the wall includes fridge/ freezer, hot water pot, coffee pot, microwave & dishes. The closet fits the queen size bed just right! And has hanging space & cubbies for storage. Modern bathroom with large shower. Private entrance via shared utility hallway ensures privacy.

name: Modern Luxury 3BR near Golden Gate Park & Presidio
description: SAN FRANCISCO COMFORT & STYLE Brand-new 3-bed, 2-bath luxury flat with top rated Avocado Green mattresses, radiant underfloor heating, full gourmet kitchen & 4K smart TVs. Ultra-fast ~1 Gbps WiFi & luxurious EO bath products. Steps from Golden Gate Park, world-class restaurants & beaches + quick access to Alcatraz, Muir Woods, Fisherman’s Wharf, Chinatown & the Golden Gate Bridge. Plus, contact-free check-in & easy street parking - all perfect for families, business travelers & groups.

name: Renovated private SF/Excelsior suite
description: Renovated ground floor suite with private bathroom, bedroom with king-size bed and back room with table, microwave, and fridge (NO kitchen). Up to 2 extra guests can sleep on the (king-size) daybed in the back room. We are in the Excelsior neighborhood, two blocks away from Mission Street with many restaurants, cafes, etc. Easy access to the whole of San Francisco and local airports. Street parking is free, but there is NO GUARANTEED PARKING SPOT. Please read the notes and check the floorplan!

name: Wyndham at the Opera San Fran
description: Located just steps away from the San Francisco War Memorial Opera House and Louise M. Davies Symphony Hall, this cozy resort is your preamble to the finest cultural activities the City by the Bay has to offer.

name: Mid-Market Luxury Stay
description: This listing is for my entire 1400 square foot 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom corner-unit apartment. The location is very central and ideal for sightseeing, just minutes walking-distance away from the Theatre district, the incredible Hayes Valley district, and so many amazing restaurants and shops. The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located beautiful space.

name: Quaint 2BR/1BA Apt - 7 min walk to Ocean Beach
description: This remodeled 2-bedroom home is just two blocks from Ocean Beach & a 5-minute drive to the SF Zoo, located in a quiet neighborhood. It has a full kitchen with a Viking stove. Both bedrooms and the living room have large TVs. The bathroom includes a 70+ inch tub, double sinks, and a Toto bidet toilet. The bedrooms offer a queen bed and a full-size bed.

name: Top Floor Mission District Pied A Tierre - 1BR/1BA
description: Sunny top floor apartment in the hip Mission District (21 St). It is placed on a three floor building. The bottom floor is a garage, the middle floor is one large apartment and the top floor is split into two completely separated apartments. They have one door to access a common hallway and then separate doors to each unit. One of those two apartments (the one at the left, facing the back yard) is for you. The owner lives two blocks away.

name: Urban Retreat: 1BR Suite at Wyndham Canterbury
description: Welcome to Wyndham Canterbury Resort, a celebrated destination that seamlessly blends history with contemporary style. Nestled in the heart of San Francisco, this iconic resort has been thoughtfully renovated to offer a captivating and comfortable stay. Unwind in the inviting living area and take in the surroundings of your home away from home. The suite features a partial kitchenette, perfect for preparing light meals and snacks at your convenience.

name: Charming, Spacious Noe 1-br
description: This comfortable, spacious apartment is perfect for anyone looking for a soft place to land in San Francisco. You'll be within a few blocks of anything you might need: a half a dozen restaurants, a neighborhood grocer, a butcher shop, a dive bar, the best ice cream in town, and a lovely "slow street" that's been blocked to through traffic since the pandemic. Direct access to a beautiful backyard, an Apple TV for all your viewing needs, a workspace, and a well-stocked kitchen to round it out.

name: Historic Private Penthouse W/ Laundry Service
description: Beautiful upscale private penthouse unit in one of the few historically registered residential houses in San Francisco. The building was built in 1865 and is conveniently located in Jackson Square, blocks away from the San Francisco Ferry Building, Embarcadero, Chinatown, North Beach, and the Financial District. Unobstructed views of TransAmerica with private rooftop deck and access to an even larger garden patio with a gas grill and heaters. For stays over 30 days we offer laundry service.

name: Noe Castro Sunny Modernism 2 BR
description: Elegantly restored by a renowned San Francisco architect, these accommodations offer a modernist esthetic and a quality environment for a very reasonable price. It is located on the border between San Francisco’s most desirable, vibrant and centrally located neighborhoods, Noe Valley and the Castro. The adjacent Muni lines offer connection to the central Castro station with BART (Bay Area Rapid Transportation) Early Check In, Late Check Out: $25/hour.

name: Park Presidio
description: Newly remodeled and economical two bedroom. Well outfitted kitchen. New bathroom. Lots of natural light. Close to public transport, restaurants and shops. Near the Presidio and Golden Gate Park. Near lively Clement Street.

name: Next to Transit, Grocery, Dining
description: Less one block from: Transit: J Car, 24 (immediately outside) Grocery Market Toast Eatery (in building) Oki Sushi (next door) Clay Oven Twin Peaks Pizza Recreation Center: Free Zumba Classes, Karate Class, and many more available on Schedule Indoor Basketball Courts Tennis Court Indoor Children’s Play Center Playground Mobu Dance Studio (across street)

name: Large, quiet room in heart of SF
description: Enjoy everything SF has to offer in this large, well-appointed room in a lovely Victorian home at 14th/Valencia. The home is located in the highly desirable Mission Dolores neighborhood and is a quick walk to everything, including the 16th/Mission Bart. You’ll have fast Wi-Fi, a queen bed, a desk and chair, a large closet, a claw foot tub/shower, washer/dryer, and a great kitchen. This is a private room that shares a bathroom with 3 other guests. Please note- this is a third floor walk up!

name: 2BR Apt in Mission walkable to Bart & Muni
description: Great location if you need to be near public transportation. We are less than 1/2 mile to the 24th St Bart Station. Walkable to several restaurants, coffee shops and bars. Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital is 1/2 mile from the apartment.

name: Contemporary Garden Carriage House
description: Relax, Entertain, WFH or Hibernate in this gorgeous, sun-filled apartment -- ½ block from 3rd & 22nd Streets (the main retail corridor) -- a 10 min walk to UCSF Mission Bay or a favorite playlist to The Embarcadero. The Carriage House Garden ( 2 unit) immaculately curated space designed with comfort & privacy. A generous scale & thoughtful layout emphasize comfort and functionality. Guest access Access to shared walkway & backyard. We kindly ask guests respect the shared walkway.

name: Newly Remodel Guest Suite-Separate Entrance

With Washington Square Park just around the corner that home away from home offers a large variety of amenities and attractions to complement your stay.

No matter if it is for business or leisure this is the perfect starting point to experience the city of SF.

description: Welcome to San Francisco! This open layout 3-story townhome is a gem, filled with natural sunlight and modern upgrades to make your stay feel like home. Enjoy southern skyline and bay views from the classic SF bay windows. Located in Potrero Hill, one of the sunniest and fog-less neighborhoods of SF, it offers the convenience of living in the city with the comfort and safety of a quaint residential community.

name: Private Studio by Golden Gate Park
description: Relax in a newly renovated private studio located in the heart of San Francisco (Richmond District). Golden Gate Park is only a few blocks away provide great outdoor activities and within short walk to local bars and a diverse array of eateries. Public transits offer convenient pathways to famous landmarks and museums. It is a perfect place to immerse yourself in this quiet place or explore all that urban allure has to offer.

name: Queen Bed with Roofdeck
description: Discover San Francisco from your private room in our centrally located and safe Pacific Heights home. Ideal for remote workers and tourists, your room boasts a comfy queen bed, workstation with desk and chair, dresser, and closet. Please note the bathroom is shared. Enjoy access to a fully equipped kitchen, free in-unit laundry, and a rooftop deck with stunning views. Just minutes from downtown and attractions like Lombard Street, our home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

name: Safe Pac Heights Central
description: PRIVATE ENTIRE HOUSE RESERVATION, ONLY SHARED SPACE IS ROOFDECK Discover San Francisco from our centrally located and safe Pacific Heights home. Perfect for remote workers and tourists, this spacious residence features 5 bedrooms plus a bonus room. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, free in-unit laundry, and a shared rooftop deck with stunning views. Just minutes from downtown and attractions like Lombard Street, our home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location.

description: Newly renovated space within walking distance to SF attractions. Great for couples, or families with young kids. Located in the Central Richmond. 5 minute walk to the Presidio gate, 15 minutes to Baker Beach, and 25 minutes to Golden Gate Park. Great nature abound as well as restaurants nearby. The bus stops a block away that goes straight to downtown. The space is located on Lake Street, which is a slow street with few cars - great for walking, hiking, and biking.

name: Furnished Room in Sunset w/ ocean & garden View
description: Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space. Fully furnished with an ocean view, and a full garden view from your windows, along with fresh air breeze from the ocean. Comes with a modern glass desk, bookshelf for your things, and a full size closet and a standing mirror for your convenience. Muni 7 line and N Judah metro takes you to downtown in one ride, along with 28 bus to Stonestown mall and Daly City Bart station. Lots of restaurants and shops nearby walking distance

name: Hip Urban Sanctuary
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space. The top floor open plan living room and kitchen is light-filled and super comfortable. Step out onto the adjoining deck and enjoy views of downtown and the Bay Bridge! There's another deck downstairs, along with three bedrooms (one set up as an office, where we can leave an air mattress.) Below that is the cozy courtyard with hot tub, hang out space, and custom mural. Please note: events strictly prohibited and $5000 fee in case of party/noise.

name: 1906 Modern home by Ocean & Zoo + Driveway Parking
description: Newly remodeled single family house on the entire 2nd floor for 100% privacy and private deck. Near public transit. 2 mins to Lakeshore Plaza, 4 mins to Ocean Beach, 4 mins to Lake Merced, 5 mins to SF Zoo, 6 mins to Stonestown Galleria Mall where you’ll find Target, Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods Market, and lots of local restaurants and cafes. And mins to 4 golf clubs such as SF Golf Club and TRC Harding Park which hosted 2020 PGA Championship. Easy in & out of SF via FWY 280 and HWY 101.

name: 1 Bed 1 Bath Condo - North Beach
description: 1 Bedroom/1 Bathroom upper unit in single-family home in North Beach! Features: brick-paved driveway with lush landscaping and towering trees, 10-foot ceilings, redwood deck at the entrance, city views, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, breakfast seating, copious closets, gas fireplace, queen sofa bed, quartz counters in the ensuite bathroom, and radiant heated flooring. The washer and dryer are shared with the unit below and are located on site.

Enjoy the perfect blend of luxury and convenience in this exquisite urban retreat. -8 mins walk to N, F, K line -8 mins walk to bus stop 6,7,24,37 -10 mins walk to Grocery store -walking distance to Castro, Haight Ashbury, Lower Haight, Duboce park

Quiet, cozy and sleeps 4 comfortably.

Yard-view, walk-in closet & private laundry

description: Welcome to the heart of San Francisco! Enjoy everything SF has to offer in this beautiful room in a lovely Edwardian home at 15th & Minna Street. Your room is private and you'll share 1.5 bathrooms, the kitchen & laundry with 2 other guests. Note: this room faces the street so you may hear noise.

Featuring a suite and a large kitchen, this expansive Airbnb is perfect for families or large groups. Formerly known as the Willows Inn, the property is just minutes from the city’s vibrant nightlife, cultural attractions, and exceptional dining. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our home is the perfect base to explore all that San Francisco has to offer.

name: Spacious Corner Gem by LandsEnd trails,GGPark area
description: Beautiful corner home surrounded by gorgeous landscaping! Trees, flowers, large areas, easy parking. Unique 1928 designer house maintaining its classic style. Perfect location across the Lincoln Park GolfCourse. In a city where houses are wall to wall, being detached and in front of a park makes it a lovely home: large windows with park views, close to ocean & trails and also GGBridge views nearby. Good public transportation, all within walking distance of Golden Gate Park & Sutro Baths.

name: 3 bed 3 bath luxe house w/ free parking
description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful and stylish retreat. Enjoy a comfortable stay with a fully equipped kitchen, a beautiful dining area.

name: Entire 5BR Flat in Duboce Triangle, Natural Light!
description: Welcome to your temporary home in the heart of San Francisco! Our spacious third-floor flat offers plenty of room for larger groups and families, providing a comfortable and convenient stay. Located just minutes away from a variety of restaurants, shops, and popular tourist attractions, this Airbnb is the perfect base to explore the vibrant city. Whether you're here for business or leisure, you'll find everything you need to make your stay unforgettable.

name: Beautiful Victorian House in Noe Valley
description: Classically beautiful Victorian duplex perched atop a prestigious Noe Valley neighborhood offer a bright, spacious three bedroom, two bathroom, two level home, with lots of natural light. Private large sunny deck with panoramic views of the city and seating.

name: Cozy, Sunset Upper Floor Home
description: Welcome to the first floor of our 2-story house, located in the Sunset neighborhood of San Francisco, just one block away from the vibrant Noriega Street. Our house is equipped with all the latest appliances. You will have access to the entire first floor with a separated entrance. Our house is perfect for families, with 3 bedrooms, including 1 with a queen-size bed and 2 with single beds. There are plenty of toys and books for kids to enjoy, as well as a variety of board games for all ages.

name: Mint Hill Two Bedroom
description: Keep Located in the center of San Francisco. Close to Mission and the Castro. Windows on a garden. Natural light and office. Full bath and kitchen. Easy access to public transport, restaurants and shopping. Near several parks. Enjoy your stay at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

name: Private SoMa 2BR 3BA with Garage | Extended Stay
description: Experience San Francisco like a local in this fully furnished 2-bedroom home. Perfect for relocation, corporate extended project, or long-term getaways, it features fast Wi-Fi, a private garage, in-unit laundry, and a dedicated workspace. All utilities included, just bring your suitcase.

name: 2b2b Sunny Loft w/ parking, SOMA city heart
description: ----For 30+ days minimum stay ---- Stay in the heart of vibrant SOMA! This modern 2BR/2BA loft boasts high ceilings, large sunlit windows, and a spacious two-story layout. Enjoy a sun-flooded living room☀️, serene and cozy bedrooms🛋️, each with its own full bathroom🛁, and a fully equipped kitchen. A rare find in the city: a free, designated parking spot in the secure garage. Conveniently located near HWY 101 and 80, just minutes from Moscone Center, Union Square, Chinatown, and more!

name: 8A-Private Room (share bath) at Marina/Cow Hollow
description: Our quiet private room is located at the intersection of the Marina and Cow Hollow Districts. You'll get a good night's rest on the cozy full bed, then get some work done with fast Wi-Fi. Our room offers access to two beautiful neighborhoods: The Marina and the mature Cow Hollow. Discover them for yourself!

name: Elegant 2-Bedroom, Best Location, Patio & Garden
description: Enjoy a quiet, spacious home with two separate bedrooms, dedicated office areas, and access to a shared backyard and adjacent patio. The kitchen features a microwave, dishwasher, wine cooler, refrigerator, and coffee maker, while the dining space doubles as an additional workspace. Tech-friendly design suits remote work and extended stays. Newly furnished with hardwood floors and modern style. Located near UCSF, Golden Gate Park, and Cole Valley, with a Muni line right out front.

name: Supersize Stunner in downtown
description: This one of kind supersized (830 sf)Edwardian charmer in Heart of San Francisco. This one bedroom is very stylish, with lots of ceiling height windows that make space very lighted and airy. Elegant bedroom has a large window and French doors. The unit has a built washer/dryer with secluded small area that can be used as office. The unit is nestled between Union Sq and theater district and you can walk to Lombard street, Yerba buena /soma, fisherman’s wharf and so many more tourist attractions.

name: Story Book Cottage 1889
description: Fully furnished, one of San Francisco’s charming painted ladies from the late 1800s. Waking up here is dreamy! Home-like atmosphere with separate entrance surrounded by gardens. Rear Garden with Sundeck & Brick Patio extends the use of this apartment. Natural light streams in from the east, south and west with views of trees from the windows. Warm real oak flooring throughout make this cottage-like residence a joy to come home to. Added on the eastern side is an office nook.

name: New Modern Renovated Apt - N. Beach/Telegraph Hill
description: Newly remodeled modern and beautifully arranged one suite apt. with quality finishes and attention to details located in the heart of North Beach, Telegraph Hill. A stone's throw from North Beach, a light stroll to Fisherman's Wharf, a respite in Washington Square Park, an uphill moseys towards Coit Tower, a walk to the Financial District and an explore in Little Italy amazing food are all easily accessible. Experience San Francisco from your own unique stay with a place to simply call home.

name: Beautiful cozy 1BR apartment in Hayes Valley
description: This is a very lovely and spacious unit. Kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances. Located at Hayes Valley which is near the geographic center of the city, which is also one of the best neighborhoods in San Francisco with its beer garden, outdoor cinema, fantastic shopping, restaurants and artisan coffee. Close to everything...take a 2 block jog to Golden Gate Park, smoke 2 cigars on over to Haight, skip and bow to Japantown, c-walk to Fillmore.

name: Cozy Room in the Heart of SF w/ Private Entrance
description: Welcome to our cozy, newly renovated, and beautifully designed suite in the desirable neighborhood of Laurel Heights in San Francisco. Our space is perfect for travelers looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay while exploring the city.

name: Heart of San Francisco - 3 beds
description: This top floor apartment, located in a charming Edwardian house, provides all the comforts you need for your summer stay: three elegant bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a modern bathroom. Ideally situated in Cole Valley, near Haight Ashbury, with restaurants, cafes, and shops nearby, as well as easy access to public transportation. Just a 5-minute walk from Golden Gate Park. Bedroom 1 : King Bed Bedroom 2 : Queen Bed Bedroom 3 : Kid rooms (can accommodate two kids) Quiet street

name: 1 Bedroom Suite in the Heart of Fisherman's Wharf
description: Take a short stroll to the unforgettable sights of the waterfront & the shops of Ghirardelli Square. Or hop aboard a city bus, cable car, both of which stop at the front door of the resort. Explore dining, shopping, arts and nightlife in Chinatown, North Beach & Pacific Heights. • Guest checking in must be 18+ with valid ID & card for $250 refundable security deposit (credit card only) • Name on reservation must match photo ID at check-in • Parking $47/day

name: Private oasis with city views, deck
description: Welcome home to your private sunlit apartment with city views. Take your morning coffee on the large private deck with views from Sutro tower to downtown to Bernal hill. This stylish home features a large bedroom with queen size bedroom with TV & 2 generous closets, adorable kitchen for home cooking, kitchen dining table, desk, comfortable and spacious living room surrounded by windows, washer & dryer, cable & wifi, and ample free street parking. Make this your city view oasis!

name: Luxury 3Bed/2Bath Victorian Remodelled Duboce Home
description: 1904 Victorian extensively renovated 3 bed/ 2 bath home with refined modern details. Luxurious feel: 12+ ft.ceilings, open living dining room plan, large windows brings the views in, white oak flooring, custom Italian gourmet kitchen, 48" Gas Fireplace Spa-like italian bathrooms, private deck and garden. Furnishings: Eames dining chairs, Saarinen dining table, ligneroset togo couch, and so much more. Walkable Duboce Triangle area has shops, restaurants and the subway are all within one block.

name: Hip & Modern 3br/3ba: Deck-Yard-Views-90 WalkScore
description: Amazing indoor/outdoor living! Beautifully remodeled, contemporary, 2-level house-like condominium offering 3BR/3BA, high ceilings, hardwood floors, upper level deck with stunning city views, and a serene backyard perfect for summer days. Ideal location among the tidy rows of Victorian homes, highly walkable streets, and lovely little shops and cafés of the Noe Valley neighborhood. Half a block from the best Slow Street in town and a gorgeous 7 min walk to Noe Valley downtown. A must stay!

name: Luxury house-heart of SF-near beach-w/gym and yard
description: Luxurious detached 3 bedroom sunny modern house in the heart of San Francisco just 2 miles from the ocean, and within walking distance to subway station, restaurants, bars, and shops- kitchen fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances- adjacent dining area seats 8 -safe and quiet neighborhood -plenty of parking. Stay active and healthy during your stay with the provided Peloton and treadmill, and enjoy the private yard and deck for outdoor relaxation or alfresco dining.

name: Hilltop Gem with Stunning View of City and Bay
description: Stay in the best neighborhood in San Francisco, Noe Valley! Our modern and stylish junior 1-bedroom flat is beneath a Victorian-era house, perched on one of our famous hills. At the top of a set of stairs, it's a private unit with a separate entrance, dedicated bathroom, and laundry. It's your home in SF! Perfect for two people and close to local restaurants and boutiques, the location is fantastic - WalkScore 93 - with an easy stroll to the quaint village on 24th Street in Noe Valley.

name: Cozy room in the heart of SF
description: Enjoy everything SF has to offer in this cozy room in a lovely Victorian home at 14th/Valencia. We are in the highly desirable Mission Dolores neighborhood and are a quick walk to the 16th/Mission Bart. You’ll have fast Wi-Fi, a full size bed, a modern bath and kitchen and washer/dryer. This is a small private room that shares a bathroom with 3 other guests. Please note that the room does not have a closet and, while it does have a small desk, is not ideal for working from home.

name: Elegant and Spacious 2bdrm 2bth beautiful
description: Great location: • Steps away from prime Chestnut Street • Very close to Marina Green • Within walking distance to Crissy Field • Major transportation lines are nearby • Very easy access to the northbound 101 freeway • Public transportation is readily available on both Chestnut and Union Streets, as well as the tech bus lines. All scores for this area are excellent with transit score of 81, walk score of 87, and bike score at 82 with flat roads and excellent bike lanes.

name: Live-Work Downtown San Francisco Loft
description: Furnished Live-Work industrial-style loft with exposed timber and bricks, floating staircase, expansive windows and soaring ceiling. Centrally located and walking distance to Caltrain, BART and Salesforce Transit center. Parking for one car.

name: Amazing 2 bedroom in SFc
description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

name: Studio Middle Unit
description: Our beautiful Californian suites feature one bedroom with a queen bed, kitchenette, with a stall shower. Max 2 guests including children. Please note that the photos are a representation of the unit, and the unit received may look slightly different. Special requests for specific unit numbers cannot be guaranteed. Units do NOT have A/C. Wifi is available throughout unit and property. Wifi speed: 1GB

name: • Cozy & Comfortable Castro Artist's Studio •
description: Modern, peaceful apartment in the heart of the Castro—just 3 blocks from vibrant bars, restaurants & cafés at Castro & Market. Walk to MUNI & BART for easy access to all of SF. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a quiet space to relax after a day of exploring the city. Perfect for both business and leisure travelers seeking comfort, style, and a central location.

name: Hilltop studio w/t panoramic view, garden, parking
description: Welcome to our charming guest suite on top of Bernal Heights Hill with stunning views! Located in this vibrant, charming, and super safe neighborhood, this spacious suite is perfect for your SF adventure. It is a private studio space on the ground floor separate from the main house with an ensuite bathroom, a separate entrance through the garage, and exclusive access to a beautiful garden, and free parking right outside of the house.

name: Penthouse PacHeights Condo w/ garage & roofdeck
description: This newly remodeled PacHeights condo is perfect for your family stay in San Francisco. Nestled on one of the most picturesque and safe streets – only 2 blocks from all the Fillmore Street has to offer. This is our family of four's primary home. We'll be traveling this summer when rented. This is a two-unit condo and you've got the entire top floor + shared roof deck access + single car garage

name: Modern style 1 Bedroom apartment
description: Bright, cute one bedroom apartment with wireless high-speed internet. With top-of-the-line appliances including cooktop, oven, and dishwasher make this a mini-gourmet kitchen. Fully furnished including flat-screen TV, work desk, sofa, bed. Just imagine yourself home. Great location in the NOB HILL district filled with restaurants, shopping, nightlife, and transportations

name: Luxury Studio near Union Square
description: Located few steps away from Union Square, enjoy a stylish experience at the heart of downtown San Francisco, including walkable access to the theater, conferences, art, retail, dining and nightlife. Minimum 31 days booking required. Require signing rental agreement and HOA document before arrival.

name: Beautiful Victorian near Alamo square
description: Top floor of a Victorian House in the historical district of Alamo Square. Very spacious and bright house perfect for families with young children, couples or professionals traveling together. It's right next to Alamo Square and walking distance to many great restaurants and cafés in Hayes Valley, NOPA, Lower Haight. It is centrally located making it very easy to travel anywhere in the city. We live in the house most of the year, take great care of it and hope you'll love it as much as we do!
